messages:
doris: FYI release pipeline failed during the publish step for `sample-sdk` after the typegen run on main. It auto-bumped semver to a minor and release-bot blocked because of potential breaking types.
doris: Release log: https://release.company/flows/7890
release-bot: publish aborted: detected interface change in generated types (diff present)
doris: The regen diff shows `AuthOptions` switching a property from optional -> required in one union branch, and property ordering changed.
evan: Is this coming from an OpenAPI change or typegen tool update?
doris: No OpenAPI edits in the PR history. I traced it to a transitive bump: `dev-toolchain.lock` moved typegen from 2.7.x -> 2.9.1 in the last merge.
sam: Ah, the new typegen normalizer was introduced in 2.9. It canonicalizes prop ordering and tightens some unions when it detects overlapping names.
anya: Do we actually have a runtime break or only a type-level change?
doris: Quick runtime smoke: I ran `node ./examples/auth-smoke.js` against staging and it accepted both `{ retry: true }` and `{ refresh: true }` because runtime branch checks still support both keys. So it's type-only.
evan: Then we should avoid shipping a semver bump that scares consumers. Options: pin typegen to previous patch, add CI check, or adjust publish tooling to require manual confirmation for releases when generated types change.
sam: Suggestion: add `typegen-compare` CI step that runs in PRs touching `dev-toolchain.lock` and any `openapi.yaml`. If diff, post inline with `regen-bot` and require human ack.
doris: Also propose adding a tiny integration test that `dtslint`-verifies the exported API surface for `sample-sdk` (asserts shapes for a couple of high-level types). That would fail fast.
regen-bot: Actionable: created regen-diff comment on PR #3142 with unified diff and instructions to reproduce: `yarn regen && git diff -- sample-sdk/dist`
release-bot: Filed incident: REL-5023 - prevented accidental minor publish due to regenerated types.
evan: Short-term: revert the toolchain lock change on main to restore previous generated artifacts and unblock publish. Long-term: make regen diffs visible in release PRs and require devex sign-off for typegen tool bumps.
sam: Also add `--tool-version` pin to `typegen:check` that CI can accept as override, so local devs can reproduce exact output.
doris: I'll open revert PR and include a checklist: revert lockfile, re-run regen, add integration test, add ci step. Tagging @sam and @anya.
anya: Happy to review. Also let's create a policy doc in the devex wiki: "typegen tool bumps & semver policy" so we have a canonical process.
doris: Filed DEVEX-900 for policy + follow-up tasks and assigned to @doris and @sam.
evan: One more note: we should ensure changelog automation doesn't auto-increment for generated-only diffs. Otherwise it will create noise.
release-bot: Noted. I will add a rule to skip version bump if only generated types changed and human-approved compatibility flag is set.
doris: OK reverting now. Will post PR and follow-ups. Thanks folks.
